name: LitQA
description: LitQA is a benchmark requiring retrieval and synthesis of information from full-text scientific papers to answer complex scientific questions, designed to evaluate retrieval-augmented generative agents like PaperQA.
reputation: A specialized benchmark used in the retrieval-augmented scientific QA community, but not broadly standardized outside that niche.
notes: Designed to push scientific QA closer to human research performance by requiring retrieval and synthesis from full-text papers.
